paper.title_en: Unitary and finite self-energy of a massive classical point charge as a naked point singularity
paper.abstract_en: We analyze linear Einstein--Maxwell perturbations of the superextremal Reissner--Nordström geometry, the nonlinear self-field of a single static point charge, in its static Kerr--Schild rest frame. Using optical radial coordinates and gauge-invariant master variables, we reduce the radiative Einstein--Maxwell sectors to scalar wave equations on the half-line. The resulting master equations are of Regge--Wheeler type, with inverse-square potential cores at the optical apex and short-range tails at infinity. Hardy control at the apex, together with the short-range estimates at infinity, proves that the action-induced spatial $T$-energy forms are semibounded and closable. Closing these spatial forms determines their finite-energy configuration-form domains; adjoining the $L^2$ velocity components supplied by the kinetic energy gives the Cauchy-data energy spaces. The form representation theorem then yields the action-normalized Friedrichs Hamiltonians associated with the master operators. The static Coulomb field and its nonlinear gravitational backreaction are treated as the exact background. All radiative perturbations whose Cauchy data have finite total $T$-energy evolve uniquely and unitarily on the completed energy space. The naked singularity remains geometrically present but is dynamically silent: it carries no $T$-energy flux, supports no finite-energy bound state, and introduces no hidden finite-energy endpoint sector. We also construct the forward radiation field at future null infinity, obtaining a translation representation in which the conserved $T$-energy equals the squared $L^2$ norm of the radiation profile in retarded time.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文对超极端 Reissner–Nordström 几何（单个静止点电荷的非线性自场）的线性 Einstein–Maxwell 扰动进行了严格的泛函分析处理，证明作用量诱导的空间 T-能量形式具有半有界且可闭性，从而构造出 Friedrichs 哈密顿量，并证明所有具有有限 T-能量的 Cauchy 数据唯一且酉地演化；同时构造了未来类光无穷远的正向辐射场及其平移表示。主题深度、数学严格性与对裸奇点动力学静默性的明确结论都具有较高价值，适合研究者进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 作为裸点奇点的大质量经典点电荷的酉且有限自能
decision.abstract_zh: 我们分析了超极端 Reissner–Nordström 几何——单个静止点电荷的非线性自场——的线性 Einstein–Maxwell 扰动，在其静态 Kerr–Schild 静止系中进行。利用光学径向坐标和规范不变的 master 变量，我们将辐射性的 Einstein–Maxwell 扇区约化为半直线上的标量波动方程。所得的 master 方程属于 Regge–Wheeler 类型，在光学顶点处具有平方反比势核，在无穷远处具有短程尾。顶点处的 Hardy 控制，连同无穷远处的短程估计，证明了作用量诱导的空间 T-能量形式是半有界且可闭的。闭这些空间形式确定了它们的有限能量组态形式定义域；再加上由动能提供的 L^2 速度分量，就给出了 Cauchy 数据能量空间。形式表示定理随后给出与 master 算子相联系的、作用量归一化的 Friedrichs 哈密顿量。静态库仑场及其非线性引力反作用被作为精确背景处理。所有 Cauchy 数据具有有限总 T-能量的辐射扰动，在完备化的能量空间上唯一且酉地演化。裸奇点在几何上仍然存在，但在动力学上是静默的：它不携带 T-能量通量，不支撑任何有限能量束缚态，也不引入任何隐藏的有限能量端点扇区。我们还构造了未来类光无穷远处的正向辐射场，得到一个平移表示，其中守恒的 T-能量等于推迟时间中辐射剖面的 L^2 范数平方。
